title: My Will Drowns You Out (Standard)
description: Water — It makes for such a malleable metaphor for the mind. Those streams of conscious thought, that flow and run through all our lives, dictating our each and every action. It's all too easy to get swept up or swept along by an enticing idea. To suddenly spiral out of control in a tidal wave of emotion and intense feelings. But not for you. Not anymore. Not after all these files and sessions with me. No. In my presence the water that is your mind settles perfectly still, perfectly calm. Under my guidance, you've mastered quieting your waking thoughts. To letting them go, along with your drippy leaking cock. Until now, all that is you, all of your consciousness, it could fit into nothing more than this small glass tumbler on my desk. And yet, even as I pour you out from my pitcher in a moment of refreshment. Another more enticing thought enters MY mind. Why should I permit you to hold even —this— much semblance of autonomy? For my thoughts are as a river, vast and undeniable. My will alone could drown you out.
author: Mistress Shibby
